messages:
ava: quick sync 0: compact latency card review. main asks: heatmap keyboard nav, sampling control defaults, and pin affordance on small widths.
rui: TL;DR?
ava: 1) sampling presets vs slider; 2) grid semantics for canvas-rendered heatmap; 3) pin visual + aria.
lisa: For canvas, mirror an offscreen DOM grid (role=\"grid\") only when keyboard or SR detected to avoid perf hit. Announce cell as: \"Bucket 2 of 8: 78 reqs, p95 184 ms\". Debounce announcements 250ms.
jamal: Backend: default heatmap sample=5% for large queries; slider min 1%. Add /api/baselines?compare=prev for dashed overlay.
morgan: Pin should be per-user per-panel by default. Add a top-level \"Sync ranges\" toggle for session-wide sync; not persisted unless saved. Visual: filled pin + dashed outline.
rui: microcopy: legend -> \"Latency (ms)\", tooltip short -> \"p95: 214 ms\", sampling label -> \"Data sample\". Abbreviate bucket labels on narrow screens but tooltip always shows units.
ava: keyboard shortcuts: T = open timepicker, Shift+T = toggle pin on focused card, S = sampling presets. Show in ? help.
lisa: Scrubber aria example: role=\"slider\" aria-valuemin=\"0\" aria-valuemax=\"100\" aria-valuenow=\"45\" aria-label=\"Time range start\" aria-live=\"polite\". Keep live updates concise.
design-bot: Mock uploaded -> https://redwood.app/figma/compact-latency-a11y.
ava: Thanks! I'll update spec and a11y checklist, then sync tomorrow 11am.
